name: VisGen
description: This record contains the public research data and reproducibility materials accompanying the manuscript “VisGen: Contract-Grounded Behavioral Evaluation of Interactive Canvas Programs.” The release contains a controlled benchmark of 240 audited interaction tasks derived from 120 reference images, including generator-visible requests, evaluator-only behavioral contracts, assertion-entailment records, target-solvability records, and the 159-item Machine-Verifiable Controlled-Coverage Set (MV-CCS). The retained primary subset contains 25 development tasks and 134 held-out test tasks. The package also contains retained empirical results from controlled evaluator validation using 60 clean controls and 240 injected faults across 12 mutation operators; metamorphic robustness summaries covering 144 relation-program pairs; timing robustness summaries covering 180 executions; results from an earlier controlled pilot; integrity-audit results; prospective power calculations; figure-source data; empirical figures; analysis scripts; verification scripts; manifests; and cryptographic checksums. Important reproducibility boundary: the retained public-release artifacts contain complete record-level benchmark and audit data, but do not contain the individual browser program files or event-trace files for the expanded 300-case controlled study, the 144 metamorphic pairs, the 180 timing executions, or the earlier 80-case pilot.
